about: The Workbench icons of the ProgressQuest2 drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/pq2.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a sword over a filling progress bar) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/pq2.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. ProgressQuest2-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, ProgressQuest2.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's ProgressQuest2.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-pq2, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
